doc.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Loss of his mother, blessings and luck
summary: His mother died suddenly; he feels blessed and credits dedication plus luck.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And here you are, and you arrived in the United States and within a year you’re playing with Dizzy Gillespie. Not bad.

Not bad at all. But it has been, you know I have gone through — I’ll tell you something, Monk, the passing of my mother was a big blow in my life because she died suddenly from childbirth. She had a heart attack and bye. I saw my mom today and the next day I saw her in a casket at a funeral home. And I thought that after that my life would be

terrible. And I had some of that, right. But on the other hand I have been blessed. I have been blessed because the way I was able to, I have been able to— the musical career that I have had the way all the events happened when it was unfolding, it is like a movie. So sometimes I don’t take it for granted, I have been in this country for 41 years and there is not a day that goes by that I don’t say to myself, “Ignacio, wow.” You know and sometimes I think I don’t want to wake up and realize that this has been a dream. So
Well it’s a darn good dream.

Yeah. I have been blessed. I have been blessed also I can say, because I’m, you know, I can say that [gap] result of my dedication [gap] 38:11 I don’t know what is the other word, a lot of dedication. You can have the talent, the dedication, effort, but today you need to make these other parts that have to fit into the equation and make everything happen, and it is a little bit of luck. You have to be in the right place at the right time and that happened to me. That happened to me.
